messages:
marina (SRE lead): @channel Heads-up: We have a planned multi-region failover + load test tomorrow 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC -> 02:30 UTC. This is to validate our automated region-failover playbook and measure tail-latency during cold-cache conditions. Affected: hosted API (text/gen + chat), Redwood Console read traffic. Dedicated customers are NOT impacted unless explicitly opted in.

alex (oncall): copying runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/multi-region-failover-2026-03 — follow steps 1-6, watch the canary, abort if error-rate > 1.5% for 5m.

dmitri (infra): We'll trigger a controlled BGP withdrawal in eu-west1 and shift traffic to eu-central and us-west. Autoscaler disabled for the window. KV cache priming will run after failover.

sam (platform): Important: We're temporarily relaxing the SLO for 30m: success_rate target will be 99.5% (from 99.9%) for API gen endpoints only during the window. Telemetry flags: "failover_test" and "loadtest_2026_03" will be attached.

carla (prod-eng): Notifying two Dedicated customers on the opt-in list (Acme + FinCorp). They have approved. I'll DM if any objections pop up.

marina (SRE lead): Timeline: 02:00 - prepare & snapshot metrics; 02:05 - start BGP withdrawal; 02:10 - canary traffic (5%); 02:20 - ramp to 50%; 02:25 - full shift; 02:30 - validation & rollback window until 02:45.

alex (oncall): Quick checklist: 1) Disable autoscaler 2) Ensure KV-cache priming job queued 3) Watch p95/p99 latency and error-rate 4) Notify #customer-facing if any visible impact.

pagerduty-bot: alex acknowledged the incident.

carla (prod-eng): If we see error-rate spike but no customer-visible error pages, do we still abort? My preference is abort only on increased 5xx or clear data loss signals.

marina (SRE lead): Agreed. Abort triggers: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR error-rate > 2% for 5m OR data-store replication lag > 30s. Else proceed and collect traces for postmortem.

dmitri (infra): Note: We'll exercise the cold-KV priming script: run `scripts/kv_prime.sh --region eu-west1 --concurrency 20`. I've left the step in the runbook with expected time ~6m.

alex (oncall): Will monitor logs: 
```
# quick commands
kubectl --context prod get pods -n redwood | grep api
tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/proxy.log | grep failover_test
```

marina (SRE lead): Observability owners: Sam (dashboards), Alex (alerts), Dmitri (network). Post-run tasks: short incident summary posted to #incidents within 2 hours, and a focused postmortem in next week's all-hands if something notable.

carla (prod-eng): Thanks — I'll send a one-paragraph blurb for CS folks to reuse.

alex (oncall): I'll be on-call during the window and will ping here at start. If anyone can't make the window, flag now.

marina (SRE lead): One more thing: If the canary looks clean we will also kick off a small synthetic loadtest (100 TPS for 5m) to measure tail-latency. Expect slight increase in egress on eu-central.

carla (prod-eng): Acked.

marina (SRE lead): Closing notes: backup plan is immediate re-route to primary region and re-enable autoscaler. Contact chain: @alex -> @dmitri -> @marina. Thanks team. :rocket:
